source.map_rule: VA = base + file offset; header qword at 0x0 = base + 0x58

dma_builder_address_refs.scan_scope: whole file qword; aligned 0x0-370000 ADR and adjacent ADRP+ADD

runtime_provider_edges.incoming_value: event pointer written through x1=sp+8; must observe return and pointed event
4-byte word written through x1=sp+0xc; must observe return and word

finding_scope: direct branches in aligned code window and exact/simple address refs only; no claim about indirect dynamic calls
